targets.expr: (count((100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="integrations/unix", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="integrations/unix", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs"})) > 90) or vector(0))

sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (mps_alloy_hostname, device) (rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total{job="integrations/unix", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"}[5m]) + rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{job="integrations/unix", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"}[5m]))))

sort_desc(topk(20, sum by (mps_alloy_hostname, device) (rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{job="integrations/unix", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"}[5m]) + rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{job="integrations/unix", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"}[5m]))))

sum by (mps_alloy_hostname, device) (rate(node_disk_read_time_seconds_total{job="integrations/unix", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"}[5m])) / sum by (mps_alloy_hostname, device) (rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{job="integrations/unix", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"}[5m]))

sum by (mps_alloy_hostname, device) (rate(node_disk_write_time_seconds_total{job="integrations/unix", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"}[5m])) / sum by (mps_alloy_hostname, device) (rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{job="integrations/unix", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"}[5m]))

sum by (device) (rate(node_disk_read_time_seconds_total{job="integrations/unix", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"}[5m])) / sum by (device) (rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{job="integrations/unix", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname"}[5m]))
topk(8, sum by (mps_alloy_hostname, mountpoint) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="integrations/unix", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs"}))
